MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Partners appealed to me because vocal duets and familiar standards fit my interest in melodic singing and carefully arranged voices.",
    "That choice picked up on the appeal of polished vocal performances beyond just Christmas music."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Hybrid Theory, Fallen, and Master of Puppets felt far from the melodic vocal arrangements I wanted; their heavier sound gave me little reason to choose them.",
    "Adele's albums offered appealing solo singing, but that alone did not satisfy my current interest in voices working together.",
    "The classic rock selections did not connect closely enough with my recent listening to prompt one of my infrequent interactions."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seemed to assume that familiar, widely listened-to albums would interest me regardless of their sound.",
    "Some recommendations treated strong singing as enough of a connection, when the arrangement and interplay between voices matter to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Christmas album choices suggest that melodic, carefully arranged performances deserve more attention.",
    "My latest choice, The New Old Fashioned, makes vocal ensemble performances a more compelling next step than a broad selection of rock and solo pop albums.",
    "The holiday listening happened together in November, so I would not want every later recommendation to depend on a Christmas theme."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "Partners captured my interest in polished singing, but most choices missed the vocal ensemble arrangements that would make me want to listen now."
}
